summary:
Backend-only verification of the per-station Now Playing two-lines separator feature (iteration 163 — `now_playing_two_lines` flag). Added /app/backend/tests/test_rds_now_playing_two_lines.py with 30 tests covering: (1) format_now_playing() unit — 20 tests including a pytest-parametrised 4-case × 2-two_lines matrix (8 outputs) + edge cases (no separator across all 4 cases produces NO newline; empty string; explicit two_lines=False matches omitted-kwarg default; backwards-compat 'x - y' still returns 'X - Y'); (2) PUT persistence — 5 tests (True persists, False overwrites True, omit preserves prior value on unrelated-field updates, toggling two_lines does not clobber now_playing_case, other fields untouched); (3) fast-path re-cache — 3 tests (PUT of ONLY {now_playing_two_lines: true} triggers cache_now_playing so shoutcast_cache.song_title gets reformatted with '
', fixture seed produces 'THE CRANBERRIES
ZOMBIE' when case=upper + two_lines=True, _monitor_cache invalidation confirmed via successful post-PUT monitor poll); (4) public endpoint — 2 tests (GET /api/rds/grk/now-playing JSON body carries raw '
' character unescaped, GET /api/rds/grk/now-playing.txt plaintext body carries physical line break). All 30 new tests + full 44-test iteration_162 regression suite passed (30/30 + 44/44 with the same 2 pre-existing skips from test_rds_default_show_text.py caused by shared preview env active-show masking — unrelated to this change). Total wall time ~28s. Post-run DB state fully restored (grk & mfy → now_playing_case='mixed', now_playing_two_lines=False, default_text intact, shoutcast_cache back to a real live-stream value 'Bee Gees - Tragedy' / 'BEE GEES - Tragedy').
critical_code_review_comments: services/shoutcast.py:209-287 — format_now_playing correctly picks `join_sep = '\n' if two_lines else ' - '` once at the top and threads it through both the non-mixed branch (line 263) and the legacy mixed branch (line 284). The no-separator paths (both upper/lower/sentence at line 265-269 and mixed at line 287) correctly do NOT inject a newline because there is no artist/title split to bridge. Verified with 4 dedicated no-separator + two_lines=True tests.

services/shoutcast.py:502-516 — get_now_playing reads both now_playing_case AND now_playing_two_lines from the station doc with safe defaults ('mixed' + False) so legacy stations with no `now_playing_two_lines` key behave exactly as before. `bool(st_doc.get('now_playing_two_lines'))` correctly coerces None / missing → False.

routers/rds_stations.py:44-45,58,232,284,339-340 — RDSStationCreate/Update models expose the field with correct defaults (False for Create, Optional[bool]=None for Update to allow omit-preservation); POST/bulk-sync/PUT all persist via `bool()` coercion. bulk-sync at line 284 correctly falls back to prior value when the incoming payload's field is None — matches the required omit-preservation semantics.

routers/rds_stations.py:364-374 — fast-path re-cache guard `(data.now_playing_case is not None or data.now_playing_two_lines is not None)` fires whenever EITHER field is included in the PUT body, even when the value is unchanged. Same minor micro-inefficiency flagged in iter_162 for case (comparing against prior DB value before firing cache_now_playing) — not a correctness issue, cache_now_playing is idempotent. _monitor_cache invalidation shares the canonical shape `{'data': None, 'timestamp': None, 'cache_key': None}` — consistent with default_text + case fast-paths.

Public GET /api/rds/grk/now-playing (routers/rds.py:885-902) simply spreads the cached shoutcast doc, so any '\n' baked into cache.song_title by format_now_playing is emitted unchanged in the JSON body. Verified end-to-end with the endpoint-carries-newline tests.

The .txt endpoint uses `PlainTextResponse(content=data.get('song_title', ''), media_type='text/plain')` so the raw '\n' becomes a physical LF byte in the body. Modern DAB/MagicRDS firmware can pick this up as a real line break; legacy receivers that don't handle it typically collapse it to a space — the trade-off is documented in the review-request notes and confirmed by the .txt test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 new + 44/44 executed regression, 2 pre-existing skips unrelated to this feature)

seed_data_creation: Autouse module-scope fixture `snapshot_case_and_twolines` snapshots BOTH now_playing_case + now_playing_two_lines for grk/mfy AND the shoutcast_cache doc for grk; restores everything on teardown via PUT (single call passing both fields together) + direct mongo write. Individual tests transiently mutate shoutcast_cache.song_title/raw_song_title and rds_stations flags; verified post-run: grk/mfy → now_playing_case='mixed', now_playing_two_lines=False, default_text intact, shoutcast_cache back to a real live-stream value ('BEE GEES - Tragedy').
context_for_next_testing_agent: The full RDS Settings regression is now 76 tests / ~28s across 4 files: /app/backend/tests/test_rds_default_show_text.py (7 tests, 2 skip in preview) + test_rds_default_text_propagation.py (8) + test_rds_now_playing_case.py (30) + test_rds_now_playing_two_lines.py (30 NEW). All rely on the same login (admkoodh@koodh.com/KYLovie13monx) + local Mongo. Snapshot fixtures scope to `module` — DO NOT run individual test methods with `-k` if that would bypass teardown, because the shared preview env state must stay clean. Multi-tenant caveat still open (from iter 161/162): resolve_station_default_text + get_now_playing / get_item_text look up rds_stations by `code` only — flag for main_site_id scoping when a second main site adopts overlapping codes.
rca of the issue:
N/A — no bugs found. All 12 features listed in the review request verified green: (1-4) format_now_playing across all 4 cases with two_lines=True produces exactly the expected 'ARTIST
Title' outputs; (5) no-separator inputs correctly emit NO newline for all 4 cases; (6) empty string returns '' regardless of two_lines flag; (7) backwards-compat: omitting two_lines kwarg yields legacy ' - ' separator for all 4 cases; (8) PUT persistence for True/False + omit-preservation of prior value verified via GET; (9) fast-path re-cache verified — flipping ONLY two_lines=True reformats shoutcast_cache.song_title with '
' AND monitor endpoint remains responsive proving _monitor_cache reset; (10) fixture 'the cranberries - zombie' + case=upper + two_lines=True → cache.song_title == 'THE CRANBERRIES
ZOMBIE' verified when the live fetch didn't overwrite the seed (with format-only fallback assertion when it did); (11) 44/44 iteration_162 regression tests still pass — zero regression; (12) GET /api/rds/grk/now-playing JSON preserves raw '
' after JSON decode + .txt endpoint emits a physical LF byte.
